clue.text: Hot-looking athlete or climber

parts.note: someone flushed and hot-looking is red-faced, scarlet in colour
a runner is a track athlete

explanation.surface: A sprinter flushed red from effort, or perhaps someone scaling a rock face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Climber' sounds like a mountaineer, but it is the plant: a bean that twines up canes.
explanation.definitionFit: This bean is a twining plant grown up poles, so gardeners call it a climber.

clue.text: Get it all together, but not in time to pass

indicators.note: to here means added on to, so the late piece follows the pass

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
not in time means late

explanation.surface: Someone who manages to gather everything up but arrives too late to get through.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather sheets or information into order is to assemble it all, the idea of getting it together.

clue.text: Dance and swim

definitions.meaning: as when a head swims, to feel giddy and stagger

explanation.surface: An instruction to dance and then go swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a Scottish country dance; the other is to whirl giddily, as a head swims.

clue.text: Junior officers made to climb the mast

definitions.meaning: the lowest commissioned rank in some navies
flags hoisted up a ship's mast

explanation.surface: Young naval officers ordered aloft up the rigging as a punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the most junior naval officer rank and the flags a ship hoists to show nationality.

clue.text: Meetings possibly raise about 50

indicators.note: about means the rearranged word is placed around the number's letters
possibly signals that the word raise may be rearranged

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Gatherings that might push up a figure of around fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges RAISE; 'about' puts it around the Roman fifty. The setter seems to have slipped: one L leaves the answer a letter short, as two are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Political or protest gatherings of supporters are mass meetings.

clue.text: Upright fellow

annotationWithheld.why: Upright fellow (4) for NEIL: no reading of 'Upright' gives NEIL or LIEN as a fellow; the clue looks garbled as held and no source gives it

clue.text: European currency used on road repairs in S America

parts.note: the ECU was the European Currency Unit, forerunner of the euro

indicators.note: repairs signals the word road is mended into a new order

explanation.surface: Old Euro money spent fixing roads somewhere in South America.
explanation.walkthrough: The ECU was replaced by the euro in 1999, so it is old money now; 'used on' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a republic on the Pacific coast of the southern continent, straddling the equator.

clue.text: One well-liked at work has plenty of backing

definitions.meaning: the office darling, a favourite at the company
in betting, the horse most heavily backed

explanation.surface: A popular colleague who enjoys lots of support.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm is a business, so the darling of one is its pet; and in racing the phrase is a strongly backed runner.

clue.text: Isn't he particular what he sells?

definitions.text: Isn't he particular what he sells?

parts.words: Isn't he particular what he sells?
parts.note: particular is set against its opposite: a trader not fussy over stock, selling all sorts rather than specialist lines

explanation.definitionFit: A shopkeeper stocking a wide range of goods rather than one line is the opposite of a specialist.

clue.text: Complaint I will put before the Head

indicators.note: put before places the first piece ahead of the second

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I will
a ness is a headland, a head jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A grievance that someone will take to the headteacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Head' suggests a headteacher, but it is a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint in the medical sense is an ailment or disease.

clue.text: Hawaiian offering certainly enjoyed by holiday-makers

parts.note: a lei is the garland of flowers offered to visitors in Hawaii
sure means certainly, as in sure, I'll come

explanation.surface: Tourists in Hawaii are definitely glad of their flower garlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Free time and relaxation are what people on holiday have to enjoy.

clue.text: A divided populace in Biblical land

indicators.note: divided means the letter A splits the crowd word in two

parts.note: the mob is the common people, the populace

explanation.surface: A people split into factions in an Old Testament country.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a kingdom east of the Dead Sea in the Old Testament, home of Ruth.

clue.text: Arthur's head is in a drink once more

indicators.note: is in means the initial goes inside the spirit

parts.note: gin is a drink

indicators.note: head means the first letter of Arthur's name

explanation.surface: King Arthur's head ends up in a drink for a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: Once more is a plain synonym for repeated another time.

clue.text: Three-speed gears give one the advantage

indicators.note: the gears give up some of their letters, yielding a run of them

explanation.surface: A bicycle's three-speed gearing gives its rider a head start.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'speed gears': spe-ED GE-ars.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the upper hand over a rival is having the advantage, a lead.

clue.text: Intends to gain wealth

explanation.surface: Someone who plans to get rich.
explanation.definitionFit: To have in mind is one sense; a person of private income has resources, the other.

clue.text: He gives things away — but is not admired for it

definitions.text: He gives things away — but is not admired for it

parts.words: He gives things away — but is not admired for it
parts.note: giving things away suggests generosity, but here it means betraying secrets, which earns contempt

explanation.definitionFit: A telltale who informs on others gives away secrets and is despised as a snitch.

clue.text: Eternal problem of unstable sea-legs

indicators.note: unstable signals the letters of sea-legs wobble into a new order

explanation.surface: Seasickness from never finding one's balance aboard ship is a problem forever.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that never grows old is everlasting, timeless.

clue.text: A grain's turned to wine

indicators.note: turned means the letters of a grain's are rearranged

parts.note: the letters A, GRAIN and the S of the possessive are all used

explanation.surface: Some grain has been fermented into a wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish punch made from red wine, fruit and sugar is a wine drink.

clue.text: Fundamental shifting in cargo

indicators.note: shifting tells us the letters of in cargo are moved about

explanation.surface: A basic problem with the cargo shifting in the hold.
explanation.definitionFit: Organic in the sense of structural, inherent or basic to a thing's make-up.

clue.text: Storm into gas service stations

indicators.note: into means the fury word goes inside the word gas

parts.note: to storm is to rage

explanation.surface: Someone bursting angrily into a gas supply company.
explanation.definitionFit: Places that repair cars and sell fuel are service stations.

clue.text: Coming from China, it is bottled in Italy

indicators.note: coming from signals the letters of China and it are made into something new

explanation.surface: Something exported from China, though bottled in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' and 'it' together give seven letters, rearranged into the Tuscan wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tuscan red wine is a product put in bottles in Italy.

clue.text: Raced round one circuit and made a hit

indicators.note: round means the speed word goes around the circuit word

parts.note: raced means sped
a lap is one circuit of a track

explanation.surface: A driver sped round a lap and had a big success.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike someone with the open hand is to deliver a hit.

clue.text: He may have to wait for his money

definitions.text: He may have to wait for his money

parts.words: He may have to wait for his money
parts.note: wait here means to wait at table, a domestic's duty for wages, not to wait patiently for payment

explanation.definitionFit: A domestic employee such as a butler waits on his employer in return for wages.

clue.text: Friend failed to speak-he could tell you a lot

definitions.text: he could tell you a lot

parts.note: a pal is a friend

indicators.note: to speak signals the word for failed is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: missed means failed, as in missed the target

explanation.surface: A friend who couldn't talk, though he could say plenty.
explanation.walkthrough: MIST is heard as MISSED. 'a lot' means one's lot, one's fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand reader reveals one's lot, one's destiny, from the lines of the hand.

clue.text: Unusual artist about

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: An eccentric painter knocking around.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare means uncommon, seldom found.

clue.text: Like whisky, if rye is used to make it

indicators.note: the words if and rye are the raw material used to make it, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A whisky made from rye grain, if you use it.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong spirits burn the throat, so whisky is described as hot and fiery.

clue.text: Measure a girl

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of cloth length

explanation.surface: Sizing up a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, as of the singer Fitzgerald.

clue.text: Ring starts nervous reaction in the ear

indicators.note: starts means the ring shape begins the word, coming first

parts.note: a ring is O-shaped
a tic is a nervous twitch

explanation.surface: A ringing sound triggers a twitch in the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the ear is the anatomical sense, as in aural.

clue.text: Duty on one type of passenger conveyance

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed after, so the numeral follows

parts.note: a duty is a tax
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A levy imposed on one kind of vehicle carrying passengers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab for hire carries fare-paying passengers.

clue.text: Get hint about contract

indicators.note: about signals the letters of get hint are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Grasp the hint regarding a business agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' looks like a noun, but here it is the verb: draw together.
explanation.definitionFit: To contract is to draw together or make taut.

clue.text: Girl, given Chinese food, wanting more

parts.note: Ava is a girl's name
rice is a staple of Chinese food

explanation.surface: A girl, fed a Chinese meal, still hungry for more.
explanation.definitionFit: Greed is a craving for more than one needs.

clue.text: Those with the mind to study say this script is flawed

definitions.text: Those with the mind to study

indicators.note: is flawed means the letters of say this script are faulty and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Critics remark that a written text is faulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctors who specialise in mental illness make the mind their study.
